title: Type Definitions
description: TypeScript-style type definitions for API data structures

Device.python:
from typing import Optional, Literal, Dict

class Device(TypedDict, total=False):
    id: str
    ip: Optional[str]
    mac: Optional[str]
    hostname: Optional[str]
    vendor: Optional[str]
    device_type: Optional[str]
    status: Literal['up', 'down', 'unknown']
    first_seen: Optional[int]
    last_seen: Optional[int]
    tags: Dict[str, str]

DiscoveryScanResponse.python:
from typing import TypedDict, List, Optional

class DiscoveredDevice(TypedDict, total=False):
    ip: Optional[str]
    mac: Optional[str]
    hostname: Optional[str]
    vendor: Optional[str]
    source: Optional[str]

class DiscoveryScanResponse(TypedDict):
    count: int
    devices: List[DiscoveredDevice]
    persisted: bool
    identified: bool

WebSocketMessage.python:
from typing import Union, Literal, TypedDict

class HelloMessage(TypedDict):
    type: Literal['hello']
    ts: int

class DeviceDiscoveredMessage(TypedDict):
    type: Literal['device_discovered']
    ts: int
    device: Device

class DeviceUpMessage(TypedDict):
    type: Literal['device_up']
    ts: int
    device_id: str

class DeviceDownMessage(TypedDict):
    type: Literal['device_down']
    ts: int
    device_id: str

class LatencyMessage(TypedDict):
    type: Literal['latency']
    ts: int
    device_id: str
    ms: float
    loss: float

WebSocketMessage = Union[
    HelloMessage,
    DeviceDiscoveredMessage,
    DeviceUpMessage,
    DeviceDownMessage,
    LatencyMessage
]
